dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, it's my birthday on Saturday. Would you like to come to my party?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪts maɪ ˈbɜːrθdeɪ ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪ. wʊd juː ˈlaɪk tə ˈkʌm tə maɪ ˈpɑːrti?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'd love to! What time is it?
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈlʌv tuː! ˈwʌt ˈtaɪm ɪz ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: At seven. I want to invite all our friends from class.
dialogue.reading: ət ˈsɛvən. aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ɪnˈvaɪt ˈɔːl aʊər ˈfrɛndz frəm ˈklæs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! Can I help you with the food?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! kən aɪ ˈhɛlp juː wɪð ðə ˈfuːd?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, please. Would you like to go shopping with me on Thursday afternoon?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈpliːz. wʊd juː ˈlaɪk tə ˈɡoʊ ˈʃɑːpɪŋ wɪð miː ɑːn ˈθɜːrzdeɪ ˌæftərˈnuːn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm afraid I can't. I have class until four.
dialogue.reading: aɪm əˈfreɪd aɪ ˈkænt. aɪ ˈhæv ˈklæs ənˈtɪl ˈfɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's OK. Let's go on Saturday morning.
dialogue.reading: ðæts oʊˈkeɪ. ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sorry, I work on Saturday morning. But I'll see you at the party!
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, aɪ ˈwɜːrk ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ. bʌt aɪl ˈsiː juː ət ðə ˈpɑːrti!
